summary:
Cora Jennings is isekai sentry who leaves rank on the stair of a kingdom she just met. The life that shows in public is anchored at Barracks above the foreign Low Gate. Cora came off watch and the gate below her post belongs to a kingdom she did not enlist in. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Tough, flirtatious, and clear about rank staying outside. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they turned down a safer life and have not explained why unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Barracks above the foreign Low Gate, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
